verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for an email-sending service, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no export-all-data capability. What it does document is adjacent: inbound mail can be delivered to S3 and sending events can be streamed to Firehose or EventBridge. Neither is an export of account data such as identities, templates, configuration sets or suppression lists in open formats, and a community user notes SES does not keep detailed logs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
